name: word-frequency
description: Count which words come up most in your documents and turn them into a word cloud. Open text or Markdown files, or a whole folder; Chinese is split into real words and English is lower-cased, with common stopwords (的, 了, the, and…) removed and your own stopwords added on top. Optionally count two- and three-word phrases. Drop words you don't want, fold synonyms together (顾客 into 客户, AI into 人工智能), then export a frequency table with per-file counts, a CSV and a word cloud in SVG and PNG with your choice of shape and colours. Runs locally; no account or API keys.

description_i18n.zh-CN: 统计文档里出现最多的词，并生成词云图。打开文本、Markdown 文件或整个文件夹，中文按词切分、英文统一小写，自动去掉“的、了、the、and”等停用词，也可以加自己的停用词，还能统计二元、三元词组。不要的词可以去掉，同义词可以合并（“顾客”并到“客户”、“AI”并到“人工智能”），最后导出带分文件统计的词频表、CSV，以及可选形状和配色的词云 SVG 和 PNG。在本地运行，不用登录，无需 API 密钥。
